_why: P3206 (02/11/2026 Paris): explicit driver chain markers. A driver whose publish combo budget is full gets { full: true, continuation: '<id>_2' }; each continuation gets { continuationOf: '<root id>', index: n }. Continuations subclass the root device/driver classes (zero logic duplication, same capabilities and flow cards). New couples go to the first non-full driver of the chain; paired devices never move. Read through lib/drivers/DriverContinuations.js only. Rules: docs/rules/DRIVER_CONTINUATIONS.md.
